SELECT y.CustomerID, y.Date, y.Consumption FROM yearmonth y WHERE y.Date = '201208' AND y.CustomerID IN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE ProductID = 5 AND Amount > 0 AND CAST(Price AS REAL)/Amount > 29.0)
